# Character

- [[Character/Calypso]] — Calypso — A nymph who keeps Odysseus on her island for seven years.
- [[Character/Circe]] — Enchantress of Aeaea — A goddess-sorceress who transforms sailors into swine on her island.
- [[Character/Eumaeus]] — Eumaeus
- [[Character/Nausicaa]] — Nausicaa — Princess of the Phaeacians, who finds Odysseus shipwrecked on Scheria.
- [[Character/Odysseus]] — King of Ithaca — King of Ithaca, renowned for his cunning and endurance.
- [[Character/Penelope]] — Penelope — Queen of Ithaca, who outwitted her suitors while awaiting her husband.
- [[Character/Telemachus]] — Telemachus — Son of Odysseus and Penelope, who comes of age during his father's absence.
